name: Cogequirmani
role: Captain in a post-conquest eastern venture
origin: Family settled in Melaka; earlier origin unverified
bio: Cogequirmani has a share of an eastern venture and is prepared to sail ahead of the main company. A useful referral is worth more to him than a flattering title.
notes: fact: Birch names him as a junk captain, says his family was settled in Melaka and records a share of the venture alongside Nina Chatu (Birch III, pp. 162–163)
inference: The editorial gloss Khoja Kirmani does not establish ancestry, and there is no basis to merge him with Cojeabrahem (Birch III, pp. 147–148, 162–163; people-factions.md §2)
gameplay: His personal manner and referrals are invented; use as a late departure contact (people-factions.md §2)
